Rule 2 (blue → round): Anne is round.  

Fact: Anne is round.

Fact: Anne is round and Anne is cold.  
Rule 3 (round ∧ cold → white): Anne is white.  

Since we can derive “Anne is white,” the statement “Anne is not white” is contradicted.
